sloka: स हताश्वो महातेजा भूमौ तिष्ठन्निशाचरः।इन्द्रजित् परमक्रुद्धः सम्प्रजज्वाल तेजसा ।। ६.९१.१ ।।
transliteration: sa hatāśvo mahātejā bhūmau tiṣṭhanniśācaraḥ।indrajit paramakruddhaḥ samprajajvāla tejasā ।। 6.91.1 ।।

translations.english: The nightranger, effulgent Indrajith standing on the ground very angry, with horses lost, was flaming with energy.
